Based on the documentation, to set the fill color of a heading in Typst, you can use a `show rule` to customize the appearance of headings. The `fill` parameter in the `text` function is used to set the color of the text, which can be applied to the heading content.

Here's how you can set the fill color of a heading:

```typst
#show heading: set text(fill: red)
= Heading with red color
```

In this example, the `show heading` rule applies the `set text(fill: red)` to all headings, changing their text color to red. You can replace `red` with any color you prefer.
